Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiment focuses on characterizing the protein composition of 15 different patient-derived scaffolds (PDSs) from breast cancer tumors. The primary comparison is the relative abundance of proteins across these different patient samples using a common reference pool. While the study also includes RNA-seq data comparing 2D, PDS, and xenograft cultures, those are not part of the MS proteomics dataset. The MS analysis is a characterization of disease-derived materials rather than a controlled perturbation experiment.
